verdict.rationale: Homebrew is itself an official CLI (`brew`), fully documented in its manpage. It supports scripted, non-interactive use through `NONINTERACTIVE=1`, `--yes`, `brew bundle check || brew bundle install` and `brew info --json` output, all of which suit automated or agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: any agent-specific guidance or machine-readable docs (llms.txt returns 404), and no independent hands-on evidence of AI agents using the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use this from administrative scripts when the desktop user manages Homebrew, for example `brew as-console-user install --yes` formula.
You can use this behaviour in scripts like so: brew bundle check || brew bundle install
List the `brew info --json` output for all current Homebrew/homebrew-core formulae or Homebrew/homebrew-cask casks.
